title: Mechanism of action of the Banxia-Xiakucao herb pair in sleep deprivation: New comprehensive evidence from network pharmacology, transcriptomics and molecular biology experiments.
authors: Zhang, Ze-Yu; You, Li-Yan; Liu, Yu-Fei; Zhang, Si-Jia; Ruan, Ye-Ping; Zhang, Xin; Hu, Lin-Lin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究半夏-夏枯草药对治疗睡眠剥夺的机制，涉及网络药理学和分子对接，但核心是中药药理与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，仅分子对接为边缘方法。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Chinese herb pairs are the most basic and compressed examples of Chinese herbal combinations and can be used to effectively explain the fundamental concepts of traditional Chinese medicine prescriptions. These pairings have gained significant interest due to their subtle therapeutic benefits, minimal side effects, and efficacy in treating complicated chronic conditions. The Banxia-Xiakucao Chinese herb pair (BXHP) consists of Pinellia ternata (Thunb.) Breit. (Banxia) and Prunella vulgaris L. (Xiakucao). This formula was documented in The Medical Classic of the Yellow Emperor approximately 2000 years ago，and clinical research has demonstrated that BXHP effectively treats insomnia. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to evaluate the efficacy and therapeutic mechanism of the BXHP through a comprehensive strategy involving network pharmacology, molecular docking, transcriptomics, and molecular biology experimental validation. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The composition of BXHP was characterized using the UPLC-Q-TOF-MS. The active compounds were screened to find drug-likeness compounds by analyzing the ADME data. To predict the molecular mechanism of BXHP in sleep deprivation (SD) by network pharmacology and molecular docking. We established a rat model of SD and the in vivo efficacy of BXHP was verified through the pentobarbital sodium righting reflex test, behavioral assays, enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay, transmission electron microscopy, HE staining, and Nissl staining, and the underlying molecular mechanism of BXHP in SD was revealed through transcriptomic and bioinformatic analyses in conjunction with quantitative real-time PCR, Western blot, and immunofluorescence staining. RESULTS: In the present study, we showed for the first time that BXHP reduced sleep latency, prolongs sleep duration, and improves anxiety; lowered serum CORT, IL6, TNF-alpha and MDA levels; decreased hypothalamic Glu levels; and elevated hypothalamic GABA and 5-HT levels in SD rats. We found 16 active compounds that acted on 583 targets, 145 of which are related to SD. By modularly dissecting the PPI network, we discovered three critical targets, Akt1, CREB1, and PRKACA, all of which play important roles in the effects of BXHP on SD. Molecular docking resulted in the identification of 16 active compounds that strongly bind to key targets. The results of GO and KEGG enrichment analyses of network pharmacology and transcriptomics focused on both the regulation of circadian rhythm and the cAMP signaling pathway, which strongly demonstrated that BXHP affects SD via the cAMP-PKA-CREB-Circadian rhythm pathway. Molecular biology experiments verified this hypothesis. Following BXHP administration, PKA and CREB phosphorylation levels were elevated in SD rats, the cAMP-PKA-CREB signaling pathway was activated, the expression levels of the biological clock genes CLOCK, p-BMAL1/BMAL1, and PER3 were increased, and the rhythmicity of the biological clock was improved. CONCLUSIONS: The active compounds in BXHP can activate the cAMP-PKA-CREB-Circadian rhythm pathway, improve the rhythmicity of the biological clock, promote sleep and ameliorate anxiety, which suggests that BXHP improves SD through a multicomponent, multitarget, multipathway mechanism. This study is important for the development of herbal medicines and clinical therapies for improving sleep deprivation.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：中药药对是中药组合中最基本、最精简的范例，可用于有效解释中医处方的基本概念。这些配对因其微妙的治疗益处、最小的副作用以及在治疗复杂慢性疾病中的疗效而受到广泛关注。半夏-夏枯草药对（BXHP）由半夏（Pinellia ternata (Thunb.) Breit.）和夏枯草（Prunella vulgaris L.）组成。该方剂约在2000年前记载于《黄帝内经》，临床研究表明BXHP能有效治疗失眠。研究目的：本研究旨在通过网络药理学、分子对接、转录组学和分子生物学实验验证的综合策略，评估BXHP的疗效和治疗机制。材料与方法：使用UPLC-Q-TOF-MS表征BXHP的组成。通过分析ADME数据筛选活性化合物以寻找类药性化合物。通过网络药理学和分子对接预测BXHP在睡眠剥夺（SD）中的分子机制。我们建立了SD大鼠模型，并通过戊巴比妥钠翻正反射试验、行为学检测、酶联免疫吸附试验、透射电子显微镜、HE染色和尼氏染色验证了BXHP的体内疗效，同时通过转录组学和生物信息学分析结合实时定量PCR、Western blot和免疫荧光染色揭示了BXHP在SD中的潜在分子机制。结果：在本研究中，我们首次证明BXHP能缩短SD大鼠的睡眠潜伏期、延长睡眠持续时间并改善焦虑；降低血清CORT、IL6、TNF-alpha和MDA水平；降低下丘脑Glu水平；并升高下丘脑GABA和5-HT水平。我们发现了16种作用于583个靶点的活性化合物，其中145个与SD相关。通过模块化解析PPI网络，我们发现了三个关键靶点Akt1、CREB1和PRKACA，它们都在BXHP对SD的作用中发挥重要作用。分子对接结果鉴定出16种与关键靶点强结合的活性化合物。网络药理学和转录组学的GO和KEGG富集分析结果聚焦于昼夜节律调节和cAMP信号通路，这强有力地证明BXHP通过cAMP-PKA-CREB-昼夜节律通路影响SD。分子生物学实验验证了这一假设。BXHP给药后，SD大鼠中PKA和CREB磷酸化水平升高，cAMP-PKA-CREB信号通路被激活，生物钟基因CLOCK、p-BMAL1/BMAL1和PER3的表达水平增加，生物钟的节律性得到改善。结论：BXHP中的活性化合物可以激活cAMP-PKA-CREB-昼夜节律通路，改善生物钟的节律性，促进睡眠并改善焦虑，这表明BXHP通过多组分、多靶点、多通路机制改善SD。本研究对于开发改善睡眠剥夺的草药和临床疗法具有重要意义。
